summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2115380804415021436))** summarizes Qingyao Ai's perspective paper arguing **agentic memory management is the next frontier of IR**: it frames memory as constants (facts), functions (skills/workflows) and operators (preferences), with add/update/delete/search/use operations, and classifies RAG, MemGPT and Mem0 within it.
relevance: A unifying taxonomy for agent memory systems.
